items.headline: Paradigm-Backed $BLAST L2 Shuts Down, Users Told to Exit
items.summary: Ethereum L2 Blast is winding down as costs outpace revenue, with $63.5M still in its bridge. Users have until Oct. 26 to withdraw $BLAST and other assets via the app.

items.headline: Kinetiq Ends kPoints, $KNTQ Dumps 23% on Paid Claim
items.summary: Kinetiq is closing its points program with a paid claim: holders have 10 days to buy $KNTQ at $0.26 from a 50M allocation. The token slid 23% on the news.

items.headline: Drift Opens $DRIFT Exploit Claims — Only 1% Paid Out
items.summary: Drift has opened DFX recovery claims after its exploit, but initial payouts cover just over 1% of losses. $DRIFT users can cash out now or wait for more funding.

items.headline: $CFG Confirms Three Tokenized Funds Live on Arc
items.summary: Centrifuge confirmed three tokenized funds — JAAA, JTRSY and HYB — are live on Circle's Arc, spanning Treasuries and credit. A fresh RWA win for $CFG.

items.headline: $NEAR Intents Says $3.8M Hack Funds Fully Returned
items.summary: NEAR Intents' GM says the full $3.8M from this week's exploit has been returned, with ~34.59 BTC hitting the recovery wallet. $NEAR's protocol had pledged full compensation.
